title: kate-core: keep a quote plain after any letter
summary: is_ascii_word treats every Unicode letter as a word character. A quote after an accented letter stays plain. The test goes in the existing pair tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: pair.rs is a private module of fanout.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only is_ascii_word. Keep the function name. The body is ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch == '_'. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not add a match. Do not touch plan_pair, quote_stays_plain, odd_backslashes_before, is_type_over, is_opener, is_closer, is_quote, closer_for, one_scalar, char_before, or char_at. The existing tests an_even_backslash_run_wraps_a_quote and a_quote_after_a_backslash_stays_plain stay green. The test a_quote_after_an_accented_letter_stays_plain uses TextBuffer::from_str of é and a caret at Offset(1). plan_pair of a double quote returns Plain. The same call on the letter a at Offset(1) stays Plain. The same call on one space at Offset(1) returns Wrap with caret_after_open true. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: fanout::pair::tests::a_quote_after_an_accented_letter_stays_plain
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A quote after é returns Wrap. After the change it returns Plain. A quote after the letter a stays Plain. A quote after a space still returns Wrap.
